why: learning_screen_test.dart overrides dashboardActiveCurriculaProvider and dashboardUserModeProvider (lines 19-27) — I grepped learning_screen.dart's ref.watch calls and confirmed it reads neither provider; both overrides are dead, left over from before the screen was refactored onto dashboardActiveCurriculaStreamProvider/coarse-track providers. Its 'renders without error' and 'shows key UI elements' tests are a strict, weaker subset of learning_screen_l1_test.dart's empty-state tests (same setup, same assertion, less specific). Only the AppErrorView regression test (lines 70-93) is unique, and it doesn't exercise LearningScreen at all. Net effect: a second file that must be kept in sync with LearningScreen's provider surface for zero incremental protection, and it's currently out of sync (see the DB-leak finding above, which independently proves this).
recommendation: Move the unique AppErrorView regression test to a location that actually reflects what it tests (e.g. a core/widgets AppErrorView test, or leave in learning_screen_test.dart renamed), delete the two redundant/stale tests and dead overrides, and remove learning_screen_test.dart per TQ-7 with the reason stated in the commit message.
acceptance_criteria: learning_screen_test.dart is deleted or contains only the non-duplicate AppErrorView test
No override in the remaining file references a provider LearningScreen does not read (grep ref.watch in learning_screen.dart against the override list)
